heading.zh-Hant: 繼位與愛爾蘭自由邦的對外關係
heading.en: Accession and the Irish Free State's external relations

body.zh-Hant: 1936年12月，愛德華八世遜位，其弟喬治六世意外繼位為英王。愛爾蘭自由邦於1936年12月12日通過《行政權（對外關係）法》，使愛德華八世12月10日簽署的遜位書在愛爾蘭生效，並規定此後擔任該目的之國王者，是依自由邦法律本應繼承他的人。同一法案第3條授權英聯邦各國承認的國王，在行政委員會建議時，代表自由邦任命外交與領事代表、締結國際協定。
body.en: George VI became King unexpectedly after his brother Edward VIII abdicated in December 1936. On 12 December 1936 the Irish Free State enacted the Executive Authority (External Relations) Act, which gave effect in Irish law to the instrument of abdication Edward VIII had executed on 10 December, and provided that the king for those purposes would henceforth be the person who would be his successor under the law of Saorstát Eireann. Section 3 of the Act authorised the king recognised by the associated nations to act for the Free State, when advised by the Executive Council, in appointing diplomatic and consular representatives and concluding international agreements.

body.zh-Hant: 喬治六世天性內向、信仰虔誠，工作上得到妻子協助；他在1923年與伊麗莎白·鮑斯-萊昂女士結婚。官網記他在1938年訪問法國、1939年訪問加拿大與美國，是首位踏上美國的英國君主。他曾在第一次世界大戰服役於海軍並參加日德蘭海戰，因此一向急於探視部隊；1939年他前往法國視察英國遠征軍。
body.en: George VI was reserved by nature and of deep religious belief, and was helped in his work by his wife; he had married Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon in 1923. The royal website records state visits to France in 1938 and to Canada and the United States in 1939, making him the first British monarch to enter the United States. Having served in the Navy during the First World War, including at the Battle of Jutland, he was anxious to visit his troops whenever possible, and in 1939 he went to France to inspect the British Expeditionary Force.

body.zh-Hant: 二戰期間，喬治六世大部分時間留在白金漢宮，宮殿在戰時遭轟炸九次。他與王后探視倫敦東區等嚴重受創地區，並與戰時首相邱吉爾保持密切的工作關係。1940年他設立喬治十字勳章與喬治勳章，1942年喬治十字勳章授予馬爾他島及其人民。1943年阿拉曼勝利後他前往北非，1944年6月諾曼第登陸十天後視察灘頭陸軍；1945年5月8日歐戰勝利日，白金漢宮成為慶祝的焦點。
body.en: During the Second World War George VI remained for most of the time at Buckingham Palace, which was bombed nine times during the war. With the Queen he visited severely bombed areas in the East End of London and elsewhere, and he kept a close working relationship with his wartime Prime Minister, Winston Churchill. In 1940 he instituted the George Cross and George Medal, and in 1942 the George Cross was awarded to the island and people of Malta. He went to North Africa in 1943 after the victory at El Alamein, visited his Army on the Normandy beaches in June 1944, ten days after D-Day, and on VE Day, 8 May 1945, Buckingham Palace was a focal point of the celebrations.

heading.en: Post-war years, Indian independence and death

body.zh-Hant: 1947年，喬治六世率家人巡訪南非，據官網是君主首次攜家人出巡。同年印度與巴基斯坦獨立，他不再是印度皇帝；英聯邦的聯繫改以承認君主為英聯邦元首為基礎。官網說他的健康因戰爭與戰後的壓力受損，肺部手術後未能康復，1952年2月6日在桑德靈厄姆睡夢中去世，享年五十六歲。
body.en: In 1947 George VI toured South Africa with his family, which the royal website calls the first time a monarch had undertaken a tour with his family. When India and Pakistan became independent in 1947 he ceased to be Emperor of India, and the Commonwealth tie came to rest on recognition of the Sovereign as Head of the Commonwealth. The website says the strain of the war and its aftermath had taken a toll on his health; he failed to recover from a lung operation and died in his sleep on 6 February 1952 at Sandringham, aged 56.

people.name: Juan Luis Sanfuentes Andonaegui
people.nameZh: 胡安·路易斯·桑富恩特斯

body.zh-Hant: 胡安·路易斯·桑富恩特斯1858年12月27日生於聖地牙哥，是政治家兼作家薩爾瓦多·桑富恩特斯·托雷斯之子。1860年父親去世後，由比他年長十歲的兄長恩里克·薩爾瓦多撫養。他在國立學院就讀，後入智利大學修法律，1879年取得律師資格。
body.en: Juan Luis Sanfuentes was born in Santiago on 27 December 1858, the son of the politician and writer Salvador Sanfuentes Torres. After his father died in 1860 he was raised by his brother Enrique Salvador Sanfuentes, ten years his senior. He studied at the Instituto Nacional and then read law at the University of Chile, qualifying as a lawyer in 1879.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴爾馬塞達派與內戰後的退隱

body.zh-Hant: 桑富恩特斯在1888至1891年擔任科埃勒穆選區眾議員，支持總統何塞·馬努埃爾·巴爾馬塞達。1891年內戰政府戰敗後，他退出公共生活、轉而經商。1893年巴爾馬塞達的舊支持者重組為自由民主黨（又稱自由巴爾馬塞達派），他隨後重返政壇。
body.en: Sanfuentes sat as deputy for Coelemu in 1888-1891 and supported President José Manuel Balmaceda. After the government's defeat in the civil war of 1891 he withdrew from public life and turned to business. In 1893 Balmaceda's former supporters regrouped as the Liberal Democratic Party (the Liberal Balmacedists), and Sanfuentes returned to political life.

Tras la derrota del Gobierno en la Guerra Civil de 1891

body.zh-Hant: 1900年自由民主黨分裂為兩派，一派由克勞迪奧·比庫尼亞領導，另一派由桑富恩特斯領導；他當選瓦爾迪維亞選區參議員，任期1900至1906年。1901年總統埃拉蘇里斯任命他為財政部長，同年8月23日他被任命為司法與公共教育部代理部長。1906年他當選參議院議長，並改任康塞普西翁選區參議員（1906至1912年）；1912年連任（1912至1918年）。
body.en: In 1900 the Liberal Democratic Party split into two factions, one led by Claudio Vicuña and the other by Sanfuentes, who was elected senator for Valdivia for 1900-1906. In 1901 President Errázuriz named him Minister of Finance, and on 23 August he was named acting Minister of Justice and Public Instruction. In 1906 he was elected President of the Senate and senator for Concepción for 1906-1912; he was re-elected in 1912 for 1912-1918.

heading.zh-Hant: 自由民主黨主席與1915年總統選舉
heading.en: Liberal Democratic Party president and the 1915 election

body.zh-Hant: 在巴羅斯·盧科政府期間（1910至1915年），參議員桑富恩特斯擔任自由民主黨主席。1915年，保守黨、國民黨與自由民主黨組成的聯盟推舉他為總統候選人，對手是自由聯盟的哈維爾·安赫爾·菲格羅亞。兩人皆未過半數，國會裁定桑富恩特斯勝選，他成為唯一登上總統位的自由民主黨候選人。
body.en: During the government of Ramón Barros Luco (1910-1915), Senator Sanfuentes served as president of the Liberal Democratic Party. In 1915 the Coalition of the Conservative, National and Liberal Democratic parties proclaimed him its presidential candidate against Javier Ángel Figueroa Larraín of the Liberal Alliance. Neither won an absolute majority, so Congress awarded the victory to Sanfuentes, the only Liberal Democratic candidate ever to reach the presidency.

body.zh-Hant: 桑富恩特斯政府的特徵是內閣頻繁更替，源於國會多數不斷變動，這在整個議會制時期都是常態。他兌現競選承諾，在第一次世界大戰期間維持中立，同時抵抗親德的支持者與協約國兩方的壓力；戰後智利在1919年加入國際聯盟。任內頒布多項社會法，並在1920年頒布《初等義務教育法》。
body.en: The Sanfuentes government was marked by continual ministerial turnover caused by shifting parliamentary majorities, a constant throughout the parliamentary period. As promised in his campaign he kept Chile neutral in the First World War, resisting pressure both from his own largely Germanophile supporters and from the Allied powers; after the war the country entered the League of Nations in 1919. His government promulgated several social laws and decreed the compulsory primary instruction law in 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年12月23日，桑富恩特斯把政權移交給阿圖羅·亞歷山德里·帕爾馬。此後他退出公共生活，定居塔爾卡的卡馬里科莊園，1930年7月16日去世。
body.en: On 23 December 1920 Sanfuentes handed power to Arturo Alessandri Palma. He then withdrew from public life and settled on his Camarico estate in Talca, and he died on 16 July 1930.

body.zh-Hant: 拉蒙·巴羅斯·盧科1835年6月9日生於聖地牙哥，父親是拉蒙·路易斯·巴羅斯·費爾南德斯。他在國立學院就讀，後入智利大學修法律，1858年12月20日取得律師資格。畢業論文談民法，題為「論農村法典的重要性」，是《智利大學年報》刊出的第一篇論文。
body.en: Ramón Barros Luco was born in Santiago on 9 June 1835, the son of Ramón Luis Barros y Fernández. He studied at the Instituto Nacional and then read law at the University of Chile, qualifying as a lawyer on 20 December 1858. His thesis on civil law, "The importance of a Rural Code", was the first thesis published in the Anales de la Universidad de Chile.

body.zh-Hant: 巴羅斯·盧科1872年4月12日至1876年9月18日，在總統費德里科·埃拉蘇里斯政府任財政部長，任內籌辦1875年國際博覽會。1884年1月18日至1885年2月24日他在聖瑪麗亞政府再任財政部長。他多次出任內政部長：1888年11月2日至1889年6月11日，1892年6月9日至1893年4月22日，1894年12月7日至1895年8月1日。
body.en: From 12 April 1872 to 18 September 1876 Barros Luco was Minister of Finance under President Federico Errázuriz Zañartu, organising the International Exhibition of 1875. He was Finance Minister again under Domingo Santa María from 18 January 1884 to 24 February 1885. He served several times as Minister of the Interior: 2 November 1888 to 11 June 1889, 9 June 1892 to 22 April 1893, and 7 December 1894 to 1 August 1895.

body.zh-Hant: 1891年1月，巴羅斯·盧科簽署罷免總統巴爾馬塞達的文件，並於1月7日與參議院副議長瓦爾多·席爾瓦從瓦爾帕萊索登艦北上；在伊基克，他出任國會代表團成員。巴爾馬塞達在孔孔與普拉西利亞兩役戰敗後，他以眾議院議長身分，在1891年9月3日至12月26日參加政務委員會。
body.en: In January 1891 Barros Luco signed the Act of Deposition of President Balmaceda and on 7 January embarked at Valparaíso with Senate vice-president Waldo Silva for the north; at Iquique he became a member of the Delegation of the National Congress. After Balmaceda's defeat at Concón and Placilla he sat on the Junta de Gobierno as President of the Chamber of Deputies from 3 September to 26 December 1891.

body.zh-Hant: 1910年9月15日自由黨大會推舉巴羅斯·盧科為總統候選人，他當年當選，12月23日就任，任期五年。他的政府延續1891年起的議會制，首個內閣由馬克西米利亞諾·伊瓦涅斯主持，只維持18天。1914年第一次世界大戰爆發，智利宣布中立；1913年阿里卡至拉巴斯的鐵路啟用。1915年卸任後，他被任命為國務委員。
body.en: On 15 September 1910 the Liberal Convention proclaimed Barros Luco its presidential candidate; he was elected that year and took office on 23 December for a five-year term. His government kept up the parliamentary practices in force since 1891, and its first cabinet, presided over by Maximiliano Ibáñez Ibáñez, lasted 18 days. Chile declared its neutrality when the First World War began in 1914, and the Arica-La Paz railway opened in 1913. After his term ended in 1915 he was named Councillor of State.

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後，巴羅斯·盧科投入慈善，繼續推動以他為名的混合醫院（巴羅斯·盧科醫院）的興建，該院位於聖米格爾。他也曾創辦全國兒童保護會，主持十年，後任名譽會長。他於1919年9月20日在聖地牙哥去世。
body.en: After leaving office Barros Luco devoted himself to charity, continuing work on the Hospital Mixto Barros Luco in San Miguel. He had also founded the Patronato Nacional de la Infancia, which he presided over for ten years and later served as honorary president. He died in Santiago on 20 September 1919.
